item.title: Version 0.6.2
item.description:
## MacBooks with a camera notch
- The closed notch is now exactly the camera's width and hangs straight down from it. A long task title ends with "…". Hover to see the full title. - The open list now fills the menu bar row above it with black, up to the top of the screen, with the same curved top corners as on a Mac without a notch. The menu bar beside the list still takes clicks.
Macs without a camera notch do not change.

item.title: Version 0.6.1
item.description:
Main Thing 0.6.1 adds full keyboard control, undo, and a reminder you will notice.
## New
- **Keyboard control.** After Show list, Add task or a click in the list, the list has the keyboard: arrows and Tab move, Return crosses off, E renames, Delete discards, Option and the arrows move a task, N adds, Escape closes. - **Undo.** A task you cross off or discard can come back for 4 seconds. The word Undo fills with white as the time runs out. Click it or press Command Z. A cross off reaches its hook and adapter (for example Linear) only when the 4 seconds end. - **Adapters in Settings.** A new Adapters tab turns Linear and Open Brain on, keeps their keys in the macOS Keychain, and checks the connection. Both adapters are built in now. If you set one up by hand before, it turns on by itself and keeps working. - **A stronger reminder.** Every few minutes the notch hops, glows in the reminder color and sparkles. An optional Reminder sound is in Settings. - **Hear sounds before you pick them.** Move the pointer through the sound menus in Settings, or press the play button. - **Settings in tabs**, a shorter right click menu, and a Keyboard Shortcuts submenu that lists every shortcut.
## Fixed
- A reminder no longer fires twice in a row.

item.title: Version 0.6.0
item.description:
Main Thing 0.6.0 adds keyboard shortcuts and a new set of sounds.
## New
- **Keyboard shortcuts that work from any app.** Show list is Control Option Space, Add task is Control Option N (the list opens with New task ready to type), and Cross off main task has no shortcut until you set one. Change them in Settings, under Shortcuts. - **17 new sounds** from Cuelume. Crossing off a task plays Loading on a new install. A choice you already made stays. - **Link sound.** A pasted link that turns into its title plays Sparkle. Pick another cue, or None, in Settings.

item.title: Version 0.5.1
item.description:
Main Thing 0.5.1 fixes the double notch on MacBooks and polishes pasting a link.
## Fixed
- **One notch on MacBooks with a camera notch.** The card now grows out of the camera notch as one black shape, instead of a second shape under the menu bar. With an empty list only the camera notch shows; hover it to add a task. - **Cmd+V pastes into New task and Rename.** - **Return adds the task in place.** The typed text becomes the new row where it is, and the empty field shows below it, with no flicker. - **No cross off line on a task you just added**, until you move the pointer.
## New
- **A pasted Linear link sparkles** when it turns into the issue's title.

item.title: Version 0.5.0
item.description:
Main Thing 0.5.0 turns a pasted Linear link into a task.
## New
- **Paste a Linear link.** Paste an issue link into New task, `main-thing add` or the API. The task shows the issue's title, and crossing it off moves the issue to Done in Linear. Set up the Linear adapter first: see `adapters/linear/README.md`. - **Links for any tool.** Adapters have a new `resolve` step, so an adapter for another tool can turn its links into tasks too. See `adapters/README.md`. - **`main-thing add` and `POST /tasks`** add tasks to the end of the list.
## Fixed
- The Open Brain adapter no longer prints an error when it runs.

item.title: Version 0.4.1
item.description:
Main Thing 0.4.1 tidies the long press menu and drops the old names.
## Changed
- **The long press menu opens at the right end of the row.** The title ends with an ellipsis before it, so the menu never covers the words. Letting go right after the menu opens picks nothing; slide onto Rename or Discard and let go, or click one. - **The old names are gone.** Use `main-thing` and `main-thing.localhost`. The `mainthing` command, the `mainthing.localhost` address and the `MAINTHING_` environment names no longer work.

item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description:
Main Thing 0.4.0 lets you edit the list right in the notch.
## New
- **Reorder.** Drag a task by its number, or the main task by its dot, to any place. Drop one at the top and it becomes the main thing. - **Add.** Move the pointer to the bottom edge of the open card. A New task row unfolds. Click it, type, and press Return. The field stays open for the next task. - **Rename and Discard.** Press and hold a task for a menu, with a firm trackpad tick. Rename edits the title in place. Discard removes the task, and Undo shows in its place for 4 seconds. - **Settings checks for updates when it opens** and shows the latest version next to yours.
## Changed
- The separate editor window, the tear off drag and Edit List are gone. All editing happens in the card. - Hovering the open list costs about 40 percent less work, and there is no dead strip between the main task and task 2. - The right side of the card has the same padding as the left.

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description:
Main Thing 0.3.0 renames the command and the API to `main-thing`.
## Changed
- **The command is now `main-thing`.** The old `mainthing` command still works in this release and prints a note to switch. It goes away in 0.4. - **The API answers at `main-thing.localhost`.** The old `mainthing.localhost` host still works in this release. - **The config folder is now `~/.config/main-thing`.** Your adapters, hooks and sounds move on the first launch, and the old path becomes a link to the new one. - **Environment variables start with `MAIN_THING_`.** The old `MAINTHING_` names still work until 0.4.
Your list and your settings stay as they are.
